title: Kill a process by its full command line
summary: Use pkill with the full command option to target a specific instance of a program based on its entire command line, not just the executable name. This is useful when multiple instances run with different arguments.

steps.explain: Match processes against their full command line instead of just the process name. This allows targeting a specific script or instance.

placeholders.name: COMMAND_NAME
placeholders.description: The full command or a unique part of it (e.g., 'python script.py')
